hero.headline: Find out how your AI fails before your customers do
hero.subheadline: We test LLM applications, AI agents and voice agents the way attackers and difficult customers will, and give you evidence mapped to the frameworks your risk team asks about.

intro: Our founder spent eight years building a penetration-testing-as-a-service platform and later its agentic AI testing. We apply the same discipline to AI systems: scoped engagements, reproducible attacks, clear severity, and retests after fixes. Findings map to the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS and NIST AI RMF, with India-specific checks for DPDP, RBI and TRAI expectations where relevant.

faqs.q: Is this the same as a normal penetration test?
faqs.a: No. A normal test covers your web app and infrastructure. AI red-teaming covers prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage through retrieval, unsafe tool use and conversational manipulation, which standard scanners do not test.

faqs.q: Can you test our vendor's voice agent?
faqs.a: Yes, with written permission from you and, where needed, the vendor. Vendors can also commission the test themselves and share the report in bank and enterprise security reviews.
No. We provide independent technical evidence that supports your compliance and governance work. Certification and legal sign-off stay with your auditors and counsel.
